worldcombat.skill.shiftgear.summary: Turns its gears to raise Attack and Speed. Torque favors stronger hits and Overdrive favors pursuit, with equal total stage gains.
worldcombat.skill.shiftgear.use.0: Become a different machine at the start of a fight
worldcombat.skill.shiftgear.use.1: Gain speed before running someone down
worldcombat.skill.shiftgear.use.2: Shift before a closing enemy arrives
The selected gear raises Attack by up to %1$s stages and Speed by up to %2$s stages, each limited by its cap. Gains remain until encounter recovery or removal.
Torque favors Attack and Overdrive favors Speed. At level 50, both gain one additional Attack stage. Interrupting the wind-up prevents PP consumption.
worldcombat.skill.shiftgear.timing: Self-targeted; wind-up %1$s, recovery %2$s, cost %3$s PP, cooldown %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.shiftgear.preference.g: Both gears distribute the same total gain between Attack and Speed. Torque favors Attack; Overdrive favors Speed. Both gain one extra Attack stage at level 50.
worldcombat.skill.shiftgear.preference.a: Consider shifting when a threat is within this distance; larger prepares earlier and risks interruption.
Stop shifting when a threat is closer than this; fall back to the normal order instead of standing still to buff.
